mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or GDP growth is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment and strong payroll growth, or the interaction between UNRATE and PAYEMS is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in industrial production signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or industrial production growth is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST is below 1000 (t-test p > 0.05), or HOUST is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a weak increase in payroll employment, signals a weak labor market and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances with high unemployment and weak payroll growth, or the interaction between UNRATE and PAYEMS is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong retail sales growth, or retail sales growth is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).
